List the current user's tasks across every project of a workspace, either assigned to them or to one of their teams

200.description: A page of the user's tasks. `pagination.total` counts the matching rows up to 500; above that it returns 500 with `totalIsCapped` set

get.description: The current user's rolling plan: tasks placed on a day, tasks still unplanned, and the recurring occurrences that would be created inside the window

200.description: The plan for the requested window

get.description: Where one task sits in the current user's plan, for the task detail: the planned day as yyyy-mm-dd in the server's time zone and the anchored minute, or null when it is unplanned

put.description: Rewrite the position of every entry planned on a day, in the order given. Ids that aren't the current user's, this day's or this workspace's are ignored rather than failing the whole call

post.description: Place several tasks on a day of the current user's plan, appended in the order given, or take them all out of the plan with plannedDate null. Never changes due dates; anchored times are kept. Tasks of another workspace are ignored

put.description: Mark or unmark a planned task as one of the (at most three) key tasks of its day. Marking takes the first free rank; with three already, 409. Moving the entry to another day clears it

404.description: The task is not on the current user's plan

409.description: The day already has three key tasks

put.description: Place a task on a day of the current user's plan, or move it. Never changes the task's due date. Omitting `position` keeps the current one if the day doesn't change, or appends to the end of the destination day otherwise

404.description: The task does not exist in this workspace

delete.description: Take a task back out of the current user's plan

404.description: The task was not on the current user's plan

get.description: The current user's inbox in a workspace, or null until it is first used. The inbox is a project hidden from project lists, not a private one

post.description: Return the current user's inbox in a workspace, creating it on first use. Idempotent: concurrent calls return the same project

Create a task assigned to the current user, in their inbox unless a project is given. plannedDate places it on a day of the personal plan and never sets the due date; dueDate is the due date. Labels must be workspace labels

get.description: Whether the current user has a calendar feed link in this workspace, and since when. Never the token, which is only shown once

post.description: Create the current user's calendar feed link in this workspace, or regenerate it: the previous token stops working. The token is returned only here

delete.description: Revoke the current user's calendar feed link in this workspace

200.description: The calendar feed status, now inactive

get.description: The current user's absences in this workspace that have not ended yet, with their private note

post.description: Add an absence for the current user: a range of days, at most a year, with an optional private note. There is no reason field on purpose

delete.description: Remove one of the current user's absences

get.description: The workspace's holidays from a month ago on. Every member can read them: they show in their planner

post.description: Add a holiday to the workspace: one per day, 409 if the day already has one

delete.description: Remove a holiday from the workspace

get.description: Who leads the current user in this workspace: the people who can read their plan and their day closes, never their private rating
The people the current user leads in this workspace. Empty for anyone who leads nobody

Read-only: for each person the current user leads, their plan for a day (default the server's today), capacity with absences and holidays, load, what they finished, the time they logged and the visible part of their day close. Never their private rating
Read-only: the stand-up of each person the current user leads, the same one they see in Today
The team leads of the workspace, as team and user pairs

put.description: Mark or unmark a team member as the team's lead, who can then read the plan and day closes of the rest of the team, never their private rating. Needs the permission to manage members

get.description: The current user's stand-up, derived and never stored: what they finished on their last work day, today's plan with key tasks first, and the blockers of their latest day close. Never the private rating
The current user's close of a day: blockers and figures, plus their private rating. Null until the day is closed

put.description: Close a day of the current user's plan: every pending task (planned that day or before, not done) needs a decision -a later day, or null to take it out of the plan-; then the blockers and figures are saved, and the private rating apart. Closing again updates it

400.description: A pending task without a decision, a decision to the same day or before, or a future day

get.description: The current user's review of the seven days starting on `start`: the saved review and private rating, if any, and the week's figures as they stand

put.description: Save the current user's weekly review of the seven days starting on `start`: blockers and the week's figures, plus the private rating apart. Saving again updates it

400.description: A week that has not started yet

get.description: The current user's hourly layout for a window of days starting at `from` (default: the server's today): planned entries placed in time, fixed blocks, the running timer, and which days are holidays or absences

200.description: The schedule for the requested window

put.description: Anchor a plan entry to a clock time, or clear it back to flowing

404.description: The block was not found
